resolution: Folded into req_1444: the 'image offset after update' was a stale host-side backdrop bake (geometry/texture cached under the stable bd.id surviving the hot reload), NOT the camera (which the user proved identical via the fixed crosshair/box/grid). Resolved by force-remounting the backdrop with a per-mount epoch busting the geometry id + textureKey + staticKey. See e9a69e9de.
